Frequently asked questions

Questions before you get in the water?

Start here, then contact W Divers for the details of your own trip.

Experience and suitability

Can I inquire if I've never tried scuba diving?

Yes. Let the team know you're a first-time diver and ask about introductory options, eligibility and the arrangements available for your dates.

Do I need a certification for a dive trip?

Certified-diver trips and introductory experiences have different requirements. State your current level when you inquire so the team can discuss suitable options.

Can every diver enter a shipwreck?

No. Diving around a wreck and entering an overhead environment involve different requirements. Appropriate training, equipment, experience and conditions matter; a guide does not replace the required training.

What if I haven't dived recently?

Tell the team when you last dived and describe your experience. Ask whether refresher training or another assessment is appropriate before joining a trip.

Prices and arrangements

Is equipment included?

Ask for an itemized quotation for your chosen arrangement, including any equipment rental and additional charges.

How much does diving cost?

Contact W Divers with your dates, group size and interests for current pricing. Confirm the number of dives, equipment, fees and other inclusions before booking.

Are specific dive sites guaranteed?

Request the sites you're interested in, but final plans depend on suitability, conditions, access and the arrangements confirmed with the team.

Can non-divers join?

Mention non-divers in your inquiry and ask which options are available. Participation and boat arrangements should be confirmed for the specific activity.

What happens if the weather changes?

Ask for the applicable weather, rescheduling and cancellation terms before confirming or paying for a trip.

Contact and language

Can I read the website in another language?

Use the language menu. Website translations help you browse; ask the team to confirm the language available for your activity and briefing.

How do I arrange a trip?

Send your preferred dates, group size, activity interests and diving background through WhatsApp, email or another listed contact channel. Your trip is confirmed only when W Divers explicitly confirms the arrangements.
